The '''jasper crystal''' was a type of [[The Force/Legends|Force-imbued]] [[tasar crystal]] from the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. It granted an individual that had become attuned to it the [[Magnify Senses]] [[Force power/Legends|Force ability]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Tasari]] [[Garuk]] and [[Valjak]] both wore headbands with a jasper [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] on them, and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Yasinda Bardak]] also wore an amulet that contained what, unbeknown to her, was a jasper crystal.

==Description==
The jasper crystal was one of the several types of [[The Force/Legends|Force-imbued]] [[tasar crystal]]s that could be found on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. Its [[Color/Legends|color]] ranged from brown-shaded to blue-black. If an individual carried a jasper [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] on their person for a number of [[Standard month/Legends|months]], they gradually became attuned to it and as a result became able to use&mdash;even if they were not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]&mdash;the [[Magnify Senses]] [[Force power/Legends|Force ability]].<ref name="Journal15" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Tasari]] [[Garuk]], the secret leader of one of Tasariq's secret [[blood cult]]s, wore a ceremonial headband that had a jasper crystal on it. The Tasari [[Valjak]], who was a member of the secret anti&ndash;[[Blood/Legends|blood]]-cult order known as the [[Kiana]], likewise donned a headband with an inset jasper crystal, with both Tasari being attuned to their respective crystals.<ref name="Journal15" />

Two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to some point during the Galactic Civil War, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the Galactic Empire, curious about the effects of the Force-imbued tasar crystals on individuals with latent Force-sensitivity, decided to subject the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Yasinda Bardak]] to an experiment. He had Bardak's lover<ref name="Journal15" /> [[Sarcev Quest]]<ref name="Sarcev">{{JCFCite|url=posts/3425564|board=Literature|thread=The Emperor's Pawns article (was: Gamer #5 stuff @ TOS!!!)|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2001-07-16|time=9:22 PM}} &mdash; [[Abel G. Peña]] has confirmed that [[Yasinda Bardak]]'s unidentified lover from {{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}} was intended to be [[Sarcev Quest]], as identified in {{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}.</ref>&mdash;who, unbewknown to Bardak, was also an Intelligence operative&mdash;gift her with an amulet containing a jasper crystal that had been modified to look like a more mundane [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]]. Two years later, after Bardak had been transferred to Tasariq and had become attuned to the crystal that she was regularly wearing around her neck, she had began to experience the effects of the ability granted by the crystal as well as her own inner Force abilities&mdash;none of which she realized the source of.<ref name="Journal15" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWAJ15.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jasper crystals were introduced in ''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 15.]]
The jasper crystal was mentioned in "[[Tasariq: The Crystal Planet]]," a [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' source article written by [[Tom Moldvay]] and [[Steve Miller]] and published in the [[November]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|fifteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine. In the article, the crystal is illustrated by [[Jeff Menges]], and in one instance, the crystal's name is capitalized as "Jasper crystal."<ref name="Journal15" /> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Jasper|jasper]] is a [[Wikipedia:Mineral|mineral]] that can exhibit various colors but most commonly is red or brownish red. It is used in jewelry and ornamentation.<ref name="JasperBritannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/science/jasper-mineral|text=Jasper &#124; Polished, Red, Banded|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2024-12-28|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20250113215830}}</ref>

"Tasariq: The Crystal Planet" suggests that, if the player characters are [[Mining/Legends|mining]] tasar crystals on Tasariq, they should have a chance of discovering Force-imbued crystals such as the jasper crystal, with the probability ranging from one-in-six to 1-in-216 of finding one or three such crystals, respectively, for every seven [[Local day/Legends|days]] they spend working in an area with an abundance of crystals. Additionally, the article suggests that, should the gamemaster player wish to determine randomly what crystals in particular the characters discover, the chance of obtaining a jasper crystal be one-in-thirty.<ref name="Journal15" />
